      Loosely speaking, arithmetic L-functions are those Dirichlet series with appropriate
functional equations and Euler products which should satisfy a Riemann Hypothesis. Sel-

associated with number fields, from automorphic forms on arithmetic groups acting on sym-
metric spaces, and from the harmonic analysis on these spaces.

directed.boundary_or_failure: Positivity must hold for the full admissible test-function class, so checking selected witnesses is insufficient; the explicit formula's analytic hypotheses are part of the criterion, not decoration.
directed.uncertainty: The prime-zero duality and positivity claim are clear, but several strip, gamma, transform, conjugation, and square-root symbols are OCR-damaged and exact formulas require scan verification.
